text: ま…　いっか　かのじょに　なぐさめて　もらおう

structure.jp: かのじょに　なぐさめて　もらおう
structure.en: I'll get my girlfriend to cheer me up

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: なぐさめて　もらおう
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with もらう means someone does that for you; the person doing it gets に. かのじょに　なぐさめて　もらおう = 'I'll have my girlfriend comfort me'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending says what the speaker has decided to do: 'I'll…' or 'let's…'. もらおう = 'I'll get (her to)'.
